source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Weapons on **DESTROYER CULT** models of yours get +2 Strength.

The first time in a turn that attacks by a **DESTROYER CULT** unit of yours destroy a unit or leave it **Below Half-strength**, once that unit has resolved all its attacks, weapons on friendly **NECRONS** models get +2 Strength for the rest of the turn. **DESTROYER CULT**, **MONSTER** and **TITANIC** models do not get this second bonus.
